verdict.rationale: Terraform CLI itself is fully open-source and self-hostable (no SaaS dependency required) — the evidence pack shows a complete headless local run (init/plan/apply/destroy) with no account or cloud service involved, confirming the core product runs entirely self-hosted. missing for 10: no explicit vendor statement about self-hosting Terraform Enterprise/state backends or independent third-party corroboration of long-term self-hosted operation at scale.
